items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 11.3.15 at source lines 1073-1076: a Lipschitz f : Q -> R_C with constant L extends to f-bar : R_C -> R_C with the same constant and f-bar(rat q) = f(q). The proof is a single application of the (R_C,close)-recursion principle, but every obligation of that principle is discharged by hand: the extension is defined on both constructors (lines 1085-1095), the limit clause is legitimate only after showing that lam eps. f-bar(x_{eps/L}) is again a Cauchy approximation (lines 1097-1100), separatedness is checked against arbitrary pairs rather than against f-bar (line 1102), and each of the four constructor conditions converts a close_{eps-delta} hypothesis into the L-scaled close_{L eps - L delta} one before applying the matching constructor (lines 1106-1116). None of this eps/L bookkeeping is visible in the statement, so the work sits in the construction rather than in a citation.
